column1: # Traditional Chinese (zh_Hant.po): what OpenCC s2tw gets wrong in this game's text, and the
# interface words Taiwan says differently. Read by tools/l10n/zh_hant.py; DECISIONS「繁體中文 (preview)」.
# phrase <TAB> Simplified <TAB> Traditional — the same number of characters: wherever the
#   Simplified text holds it, the Traditional text gets exactly these characters there. Longer
# char <TAB> from <TAB> to — one Traditional form is folded into the Ministry of Education's
# ui <TAB> Traditional <TAB> Taiwan word — only in interface text (scripts, scenes, the 入门
#   guide): the story and the people keep the shared written language.
# 里: inside (裡) or a distance (里)
# 只: only (只) or a measure word (隻)
# 回 is never 迴 in a name or "go back to"
# 干: dry (乾), do (幹), or 干 in names and 干犯/何干/若干
# 托: entrust (託) or hold up (托)
# 喂: feed (餵) or a call (喂)
# 卷: a scroll (卷) or rolling (捲)
# 斗: a dipper, a star or a cape (斗), a fight (鬥)
# the menu is the menu wherever it is named (an ending card names 主菜单 too)
# the Ministry of Education's standard form, one form throughout
